blocks.content: Clean the generator set at least every six months. Dust usually can be removed with a damp cloth. Some road contaminants may require steam cleaning.  Do not steam clean the generator set while the engine is running.  When cleaning, protect the area so spray is not directed into the generator, air cleaner, control box, fuel solenoid, or electrical connections.  Do not clean with solvents; they can damage electrical connectors.
